# identity.UpdateMeInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Changes the signed-in user's display name, photo or preferences (PATCH /v1/me).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.UpdateMeInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `displayName` | no | `personal` | New display name. |  |
| `photoUrl` | no | `personal` | New profile photo URL; null removes it. |  |
| `preferences` | no | `personal` | Preference changes; absent keys keep their value. |  |

_None._
